text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"The haskap berry fairy all the way from 
Tomakomai, Hokko Tarumae's here, dontcha 
know☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, calling myself a 'fairy' is a bit 
much, honestly... Wait, or does that 
actually make me seem more delightfully 
ditzy?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Straight from the seas of Tomakomai! 
Hokko-hoki-hoki-surf clam☆ It's Hokko 
Tarumae, dontcha know~♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I feel like this one'll make a bigger 
impression, so let's go with this! For my 
self-introduction at tomorrow's 
mini-live...!
